newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-ASPO JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-ASPO JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 34 million markka median
forecast for chemicals, electronic components and steel
processing group Aspoyhtyma Oy's Jan-April 1997 profit before
extraordinary items and tax:
Profit before extras, tax
(FIM million)
Median 34
Mean 33
Lowest 27
Highest 42
(Forecasts by seven analysts).
Aspo's four-month results are due on May 29 by 1000/0700
GMT. In January-April 1996, Aspo posted a profit of 7.8 million
markka.
On April 10, Aspo said its January-April earnings would be
clearly better than in the year-ago period.
The median of six analysts' forecasts for Aspo's full-year
1997 profit before extras and tax was 108.5 million markka (mean
108.5 million) in a 92-121 million markka range.
In 1996, Aspo's profit was 65.5 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Erik
Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken and Merita
Securities.
